rules.statement: A person managing a mosque, such as the plaintiff in this case, may have possession sufficient to maintain a possessory action if they control the fabric of the property and manage its affairs on behalf of the congregation.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that this passage rather understates the position of the muppu as defined in the evidence, but in any event the ratio decidendi was that the muppu's possession was alieno nomine."
